github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat:
Generate commit messages following Conventional Commits specification validated by lefthook:

Format: <type>[optional scope]: <description>

Allowed types (validated by lefthook):
- feat: New feature
- fix: Bug fix
- docs: Documentation changes
- style: Code style changes (formatting, etc.)
- refactor: Code refactoring
- test: Adding or updating tests
- chore: Maintenance tasks, build process, dependencies
- perf: Performance improvement
- ci: CI/CD configuration changes
- build: Build system changes
- revert: Revert previous commit
- merge: Merge commits

Common scopes: agents, webapi, web-executor, web, interval, domain, infrastructure, migration, analytics

Rules enforced by lefthook:
- Use imperative mood (add, fix, not added, fixed)
- Format: <type>[optional scope]: <description>
- Type MUST be one of the allowed types above
- Scope is optional and should be in parentheses if used
- Colon and space after type/scope is required
- Description is required after the colon
- Don't end description with period
- Add BREAKING CHANGE: in footer for breaking changes
- Reference issues with Fixes #123

Examples:
- feat: add new feature
- fix(auth): resolve login issue
- docs: update README
